name: Andy Kang
source: The former basketball team captain who becomes the first victim of the supernatural events. A transgender Asian student with dark brown eyes and black hair who wears jersey number 12. Despite facing discrimination for his height, gender identity, and ethnicity, Andy led the team successfully until his horrific death when his body was infested with spiders crawling from within.
